headline: Monsoon blues; expansion plans offer growth visibility

highlights: Despite lower footfalls, park revenue grew 10.0% YoY, supported by an 11.2% increase in blended ARPU.
However, higher-than-expected employee and other expenses resulted in an EBITDA loss of INR178mn (PLe EBITDA loss of INR143mn).
Nonetheless, addition of Shanku’s water Park (existing operational asset) in FY27E and Sabarmati Park in FY28E is expected to support footfall growth over the next 2 years.
The phygital family entertainment business model is scalable, synergistic to existing outdoor parks business and asset-light in nature, providing an additional avenue for growth.
